public_health_question.v: How have para-fluorofentanyl and metonitazene contributed to fentanyl-related unintentional overdose deaths in Knox County and surrounding eastern Tennessee counties?

ev.q: These findings demonstrate the contribution of both para -fluorofentanyl and the benzimidazole-opioid metonitazene to unintentional overdose deaths in eastern Tennessee.

notes: The design is not named; surveillance/descriptive is inferred from a medical examiner case series. The only comparison is the NFLIS encounter counts by period (2015–2019, 2020, 2021) and Tennessee's share of U.S. reports; the decedent data are composition only. The national overdose increase (28.5%) is cited from NCHS.
view_issues: The text gives 562 (73.0%) of 770 deaths as fentanyl-positive, while the table total is 572 with fentanyl 562 (98.3%). The sex percentages do not match 572 (388/572 = 67.8%, not 68.5%). 'Metonitazine' is misspelled in a note. The title claims increased incidence, but no death trend is reported.
